descriptions.text: Enchanted Fae Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet. Boy is that a fucking mouthful. By the gods. +2 to Dexterity. Light and flexible, this scale armor is made from Fae Steel. While not as strong as Elven mail or even good Orcish steel, it's the strongest alloy that fairy folk can wear. It's not the best protection, but it'll make your ass look oh so pretty.

recap.text: Donut's boss box holds her first piece of armour, and she spends several minutes furious over the tattoo on her back. With a pop, silver scale appears over her back half, hanging halfway to the floor like a skirt, with a slot for her tail. She turns in circles and asks if it covers the tattoo. Carl tells her it doesn't, not even close, but it looks great.

Edgar must tattoo Donut quickly, and the best place is her right flank, over a patch about as big as his foot. He asks someone to lift her camouflage suit and crupper, and Donut agrees only if Carl gets a matching one; the ghillie suit and crupper vanish. She turns her tail to Rosetta and refuses Carl's tramp stamp idea. Rosetta goes to work with scissors, then a razor, while Donut asks Edgar whether it could be a flower.

A box gives Donut a plain silver crupper of fine chain mail, the Crupper of the Benevolent Champion. She removes her old Enchanted Fae-Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet, worn since the goblin-baby incident on the very first floor, its plus two to dexterity now laughably weak. For a moment the shaved patch shows, with its tattoo of a dog licking itself, and the new armour appears. It is much lighter, she says, and more elegant.

beats.headline: Her first piece of armour
beats.text: Donut's boss box holds her first piece of armour. After several minutes of fury over the tattoo on her back, she moves on, and with a pop silver scale appears draped over the back half of her body, reaching about halfway to the floor: like a skirt, almost, open under her stomach, with a slot especially for her tail. She turns in circles trying to look at it. How does it look? Does it cover the tattoo? It doesn't, Carl tells her, not even close, but it looks great.
beats.gist: Donut's boss box holds a silver scale skirt, her first armour; it leaves her tattoo uncovered.

beats.headline: Lifted for a tattoo
beats.text: Edgar has to tattoo Donut, quickly, and the best place is her right flank, over a patch about as big as his foot. Someone lift her camouflage suit and crupper for me, he says. Donut agrees only if Carl gets a matching one, and then the ghillie suit disappears, and the crupper. She turns her tail to Rosetta and refuses Carl's idea of a tramp stamp. Rosetta goes to work with scissors and then a razor, while Donut asks Edgar whether it could be a flower.
beats.gist: Rosetta clips and shaves Donut's right flank for Edgar's tattoo after her ghillie suit and crupper vanish.

beats.headline: Retired for chain mail
beats.text: A box has given Donut a plain silver crupper of fine chain mail, the Crupper of the Benevolent Champion. Her old one, the Enchanted Fae-Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet, has been on her backside since the goblin-baby incident on the very first floor, and its plus two to dexterity was great at the time and is laughably weak now. She removes the old mail, briefly showing the shaved patch with its tattoo of a dog licking itself, and the new armour appears. It's much lighter, she says. More elegant.
beats.gist: Donut trades her Enchanted Fae-Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet for a box's silver chain mail crupper.

relations.note: together they make her jingle when she walks
